title: triticum monococcum var. boeoticum
intro: Triticum monococcum var. boeoticum, commonly known as Einkorn wheat, is an ancient, single-grained wheat species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high fiber content and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Einkorn wheat are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, that may help to protect against oxidative stress and cardiovascular diseases. Additionally, Einkorn wheat has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues and skin problems.
